description: This file is a PHP source file defining a migration class for database schema updates related to internationalization (i18n) in the OrangeHRM system. It contains schema creation, setting foreign keys and constraints, and data insertion tasks as part of a migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMigration to perform database schema and data updates for OrangeHRM internationalization features specific to version 4.6.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs schema creation, foreign key and constraint setup, and initial data insertion during migration to version 4.6.0.

methods.name: readlanguageYaml
methods.description: Reads a YAML file containing language data and returns it as an array.

methods.name: insertLanguages
methods.description: Inserts language data into the database from a provided array.

methods.name: insertGroups
methods.description: Inserts group data into the database from a provided array.
